newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit stays in range, seen drifting lower.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit stays in range, seen drifting lower.

text.p: * Ringgit stuck in tight range due to lack of fresh fundamentals
* Volume to stay thin through the day
* Ringgit seen drifting lower on firmer dollar/majors
The ringgit stayed in a tight range against the U.S. dollar in early Asian trading, and dealers said a lack of fresh fundamentals would keep volume thin through the day.
But the ringgit could be pressured by firmness in the dollar/majors, they said.
"There's nothing much happening in dollar/ringgit despite a strong dollar/majors," said a dealer with a European bank in Kuala Lumpur. "But we are expecting some ringgit selling today."
Gains in the dollar/ringgit, however, were expected to be capped at 2.5190/5200 due to fears of intervention by Bank Negara.
Dealers said the central bank was likely to intervene at around that level to cushion the ringgit from any heavy speculation.
At 0200 GMT, the ringgit was quoted at 2.5155/65 a dollar after opening at 2.5158/68. It closed at 2.5148/58 in Kuala Lumpur on Monday.
